description: This file defines the UriFactory class implementing the UriFactoryInterface, with methods to create URI instances from strings and global server variables, used within the Slim PSR-7 implementation.

classes.name: UriFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Uri objects from strings and environment globals, implementing the PSR-17 UriFactoryInterface.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a new Uri object from a string URI, parsing it into its components.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Uri object based on PHP global server variables, simulating the construction of a request URI.
